Follow-up to #105. [All original sections 0–49 and dispositions](https://github.com/SquirmyWormy275/SABLEHARBOR/blob/main/geospatial/docs/PROGRAM_CLOSEOUT_MATRIX.md).

The rc4 framework accounts for all 919 files at canon baseline d91a22c and 78,145 extracted geographic occurrences with zero extraction errors. This is a discovery inventory; full semantic adjudication is incomplete and OCR was not rerun.

Remaining work:
- Adjudicate the discovery long tail into sourced geographic claims, stable objects, explicit rejections/duplicates and unresolved items.
- Review raster-only material where OCR/visual extraction adds evidence; record coverage and limitations.
- Complete enterprise asset and occupancy histories, geographic event records and the remaining historical map series.
- Define and deliver future interactive views when their scope is accepted.

Acceptance: trace every baseline source and subsequent canon delta to a review disposition; preserve bitemporal/precision boundaries and archival evidence; update the section-by-section matrix. Close the whole geographic program only when its remaining criteria actually pass. This issue is separate from the accepted rc4 reconciliation and from unrelated enterprise issues.

Framework reconciliation #105 is merged at `aa0cf80467c25616ad04f6c76168db1eecaecbaa`. This issue tracks remaining program work only.

## PARTIALLY RESOLVED — September 10, 2026

### Established staffing — unchanged

The J2 establishment and HQ billet model remain locked in `docs/j2/J2_ESTABLISHMENT.md` and the September 3 doctrine: **237 billets** comprising Contact 78, Judgment 42, Orientation 24, JAG 30, Education 35 and Headquarters 28. HQ/admin support and the deputy/functional structure are already settled. Do not reopen the staffing design because some occupants remain unnamed.

### Six owner-approved occupants

The owner approved these names, existing offices and company joining years in the September 10 leadership session. Implementation is tracked in **PR #118** and `docs/canon/J2_LEADERSHIP_APPOINTMENTS_2026-09-10.md`.

| Person | Existing office | Joined Sable Harbor |
|---|---|---:|
| Jonathan Goldstryker | Head of J2 | 2020 |
| Amanda Chenahot | Deputy Head of J2 | 2021 |
| Mara Hammer | Head of Contact | 2021 |
| Anika Trish | Head of Judgment | 2021 |
| Grant Kohrs | Head of Orientation | 2020 |
| Brett Calder | Head of Education | 2021 |

**Delivery state — September 11, 2026:** implementation and final clean-source verification are complete for PR #118 head `0dd3515aadd1836a438d1f6e1e6ee9c5ec57c08e` against main `57cfa1b1c483ccf1f8b15d82c4cbdadbeef8063e`. All eight PR workflows completed successfully, including 21 focused chart tests and clean regeneration checks. PR #118 was merged into main on September 11, 2026 at 15:47:21 UTC as [`2b52933132e028bf5d9c9a8c151bb45cb0f19597`](https://github.com/SquirmyWormy275/SABLEHARBOR/commit/2b52933132e028bf5d9c9a8c151bb45cb0f19597). Main-branch acceptance of this implementation is complete. This issue remains open for the residual scope below; the approved six are not reopened.

### Still OPEN

- Chief of Staff — ROLE-39.
- Deputy Head of Contact — ROLE-41.
- Deputy Head of Judgment — ROLE-50.
- Deputy Head of Orientation — ROLE-55.
- Other unnamed professional/admin billets where a named occupant is needed.
- Exact appointment/commission histories and personal biographies not separately approved.

Company joining years are **not** dates of appointment to the current office, and do not establish J2's founding year. No additional billets, compensation, reporting powers or operating authority are authorized by these names.

Amanda replaces the discarded Joe Manyfingers proposal; no proposed background transfers to her. Grant's controlled spelling is **Kohrs**, and his corrected joining year is **2020**. Brett Calder is a distinct person from Thomas Calder; no relationship is established.

Keep this issue open for the residual scope; do not recreate the approved six as unresolved choices.
